user.title: Select a Picpak device
user.description: Devices detected via Bluetooth scan. Pick yours from the list.

no_devices.title: No Picpak device detected
no_devices.description:
The Bluetooth scan didn't detect any Picpak device.

**By default, a Picpak device doesn't advertise itself over BLE to save battery.** To make it discoverable:

1. Press and hold the button on your Picpak for **3 seconds**
2. The LED should blink to confirm the device is now advertising
3. Then click **Rescan** below

If you already know the MAC address of your device, you can also enter it manually.

manual.title: Enter Picpak device manually
manual.description:
Enter the MAC address of your Picpak device.

If you also don't have the MAC handy, check that Home Assistant has access to a Bluetooth adapter (see the official Bluetooth integration or your container/host BT sharing).

data_description.device_id: Format AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF — 6 hex bytes separated by colons. You can find it via the official Picpak app, on the sticker of the device, or by scanning with nRF Connect on your phone.
